shared_limitations: Reference patches were previously inspected by this author. These are source-grounded replay evidence, not reference-unexposed authoring or independent review.
All complete records exceed 3072 tokens; reject them whole from the bounded training split.
Early pnpm-through-Git-Bash typecheck commands are not accepted as verification; final checks invoked source-pinned TypeScript directly through node.
The Python capture CLI initially returned zero even when its captured command exit code was nonzero. Raw command metadata was accurate. CLI exit propagation is now fixed.
No V2 gold rows, train/holdout assignment, model weights or training were produced.
